SafeMath.add returns a+b and requires the result to be >= a.
SafeMath.sub requires b<=a before subtracting.
SafeMath.mul multiplies and requires a==0 or c/a==b.
SafeMath.div requires a non-zero divisor before dividing.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.

edges.reason: Owner state variable is assigned directly from msg.sender in the constructor.
transfer debits and credits balances[msg.sender] based on the caller identity.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller as the allowance owner.
transferFrom subtracts from allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender.
msg.sender becomes both allowance owner and the from argument forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on the caller being the owner.
approveAndCall invokes arbitrary external code via receiveApproval before returning, allowing re-entry.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary external token contract whose transfer implementation may re-enter.
SafeMath.add performs native addition whose overflow safety depends on require(c >= a).
SafeMath.sub performs native subtraction guarded only by require(b <= a).
SafeMath.mul performs native multiplication guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
transfer uses SafeMath.sub to reduce the sender balance.
transfer uses SafeMath.add to increase the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on balances[from] and on the allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)]).
Constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply value.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balances[owner].
Constructor reads the owner address to allocate the initial minted balance.
transferOwnership stores its _newOwner parameter into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate and promote it to owner.
balanceOf indexes the balances mapping with its tokenOwner parameter.
transfer credits the balances entry of its to parameter.
transfer uses its tokens parameter as the transfer amount.
approve uses its spender parameter as the allowance key.
approve stores its tokens parameter as the allowance value.
transferFrom debits balances of its from parameter.
transferFrom credits the balances entry of its to parameter.
transferFrom uses its tokens parameter as the transferred amount.
allowance indexes the allowed mapping with its tokenOwner parameter.
allowance indexes the allowed mapping with its spender parameter.
approveAndCall writes the allowance for its spender parameter.
approveAndCall uses its tokens parameter as the allowance amount.
approveAndCall forwards its data parameter to the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token casts its tokenAddress parameter to the ERC20 interface.
transferAnyERC20Token passes its tokens parameter as the sweep amount.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the allowed allowance mapping.
approve mutates the allowed allowance mapping.
approveAndCall mutates the allowed allowance mapping before the callback.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the recovered tokens to the owner address.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner parameter only feeds the transferOwnership assignment to newOwner.
tokenOwner parameter exists only to index balances inside balanceOf.
to parameter is the recipient key of the transfer balance update.
tokens parameter is the amount consumed by transfer's SafeMath calls.
spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approve.
from parameter is the debited holder in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited recipient in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter is the first allowance mapping key read by allowance.
spender parameter is the second allowance mapping key read by allowance.
spender parameter selects the allowance key and the external contract called by approveAndCall.
tokens parameter sets the allowance amount in approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress parameter determines which external contract transferAnyERC20Token calls.
tokens parameter is the sweep amount passed to the external transfer call.
